authority: The storage-semiconductor self-verification run has closed supplier-cut/recovery, HBM3E status-state separation, and the SK hynix customer-supply direct Outcome. It has additionally grounded CoreWeave's August 28, 2024 primary statement that it brought NVIDIA H200 GPUs to market and had H200 instances deployed. That later H200 milestone remains below Reality/Outcome promotion in this checkpoint and is not direct evidence that NVIDIA H200 platform shipments began in calendar Q2 2024. No generic or named-platform HBM qualification Reality has been inferred.
objectives: refine exact supplier cut timing and product scope in the 2022-2023 downturn
separate HBM development, sampling, volume/mass production, customer supply/shipment, platform shipment and qualification states
identify and preserve claim-scoped primary-source packets for CAP-0002 grounding
preserve contemporaneous expectations and compare them with later outcomes without hindsight rewrite

h200_coreweave_market_grounding_checkpoi.semantic_boundary: CoreWeave reported H200 market availability/deployment by August 28, 2024. This is related to, but not direct realization evidence for, Micron's February statement that H200 GPUs would begin shipping in calendar Q2 2024.

comparability_guards: Micron approximately 20% is DRAM+NAND wafer starts versus fiscal Q4 2022 and is Micron-specific.
SK hynix greater-than-50% is 2023 investment YoY, not wafer starts, bit supply or NAND production.
Samsung April 2023 selected-product production-cut wording contains no product split or percentage and is not itself executed-cut Reality.
HBM development, customer sampling, volume/mass production, customer supply, platform shipment, platform market availability and platform qualification are distinct states.
Samsung HBM3E 8H mass-production Reality and 12H production-plan Judgments are variant-specific and must not be merged.
Samsung 12H customer sampling is not named-customer or named-platform qualification.
A realized direct Outcome may still have timing_relation=not_comparable when source-supported temporal precision is insufficient.
CoreWeave August H200 market availability/deployment cannot be backdated into Q2 shipment-start Reality and does not identify Micron as the HBM supplier.

discovery_notes_below_evidence_authority.source: Micron Fiscal Q3 2024 prepared remarks, June 26 2024
discovery_notes_below_evidence_authority.note: Micron said its HBM shipment ramp began in fiscal Q3 and it generated over $100 million in HBM3E revenue. This is related HBM shipment/revenue context, not direct proof that NVIDIA H200 platform shipments began in calendar Q2.

Samsung reported expanding HBM3E sales/revenue, but the recovered claim-scoped text does not explicitly establish original HBM3E 12H mass-production realization or a named-platform qualification milestone.

next_action: Return to read-only primary-source discovery for the still-unresolved direct H200 Q2 shipment-start realization and Samsung original HBM3E 12H mass-production/qualification realization.
